description: Divides one whole number by another and steps out the digits of the answer, one digit per clock

params.text: Sets the number being divided, 1 to 100000
Sets the number it is divided by, 1 to 100000
Sets the base the digits are counted in, 2 to 16; in base 2 each digit is 0 or 1, in base 16 it is 0 to 15
Skips this many digits before the run begins, 0 to 100
Sets what one digit is worth in volts, 0.01 to 1
Sets the voltage the digits are added to, -10V to 10V

inputs.text: Each trigger here puts out the next digit
A trigger here starts the run of digits again from the beginning

outputs.text: Carries the BV voltage plus the current digit times Scl, held until the next clock

notes: nothing comes out until a clock is patched into CLK
turning N, D or Base starts the run of digits again at once, without waiting for a reset

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
